title: Impact of Obesity Diagnosis on Medication Use
research_question: Does receiving an obesity diagnosis at a specific BMI cutoff lead to increased medication use? This study aims to understand the causal impact of being diagnosed as obese on the subsequent use of medications.
data_description: The dataset includes 400 individuals with columns for running_var (BMI), treated (whether BMI is above the obesity cutoff), and y (log medication use). The data focuses on individuals with BMI values near the obesity threshold.

ground_truth.identification_strategy: Compare medication use for individuals just above and below the BMI cutoff.
ground_truth.conclusion_detail: Receiving an obesity diagnosis at the BMI cutoff leads to increased medication use.
